title: Study of Potent inhibitors for CT5-3hTERT fibroblast cell line
projectDescription: Data independent acquisition (DIA) mass spectrometry was used to study the potent inhibitors for cancer derived fibroblast cell line, CT5-3hTERT. The fibroblast spheroids were treated with 21 different tumor inhibitors to compare their effect in proteome in comparison to treated with DMSO.
sampleProcessingProtocol: CT5-3hTERT fibroblast cells treated with Everolimus, Navitoclax, GSK2256098, Paclitaxel, Oxaliplatin, Luminespib, Trametinib, Imatinib, Sunitinib, Y27632, Nintedanib, Palbociclib, Pazopanib, Dabrafenib, Ricolinostat, Lenvatinib, Omipalisib, Uprosertib, Lapatinib, Foretinib, Tofacitinib in triplicate and DMSO (9 replicates). The cells were then decellularized and the protein extracts were reduced and alkylated. The proteins were then digested with Trypsin/Lys-C in S-trap microcolumn. The digested peptides were desalted and then injected into FAIMS embedded nano LC Orbitrap Lumos Fusion system. The peptides were separated with mobile phase buffer A (0.1% formic acid) and B (acetonitrile/water (95:5(v/v)), over a 120-minute gradient (5–21% B in 62 minutes, 21-36% B in 48 minutes, 36-100% in 5 minutes and held at 100% B for 5 minutes). FAIMS compensation voltages were set to be -50 V and -70 V. Data acquisition was performed with DIA mode, in which each cycle of full scan of 395-1005 m/z at a resolution of 120,000 was performed. DIA MS2 scans at a resolution of 30,000 were performed for all DIA scans with 30 variable windows overlapped by 1 m/z. DIA spectra of both FAIMS compensation voltages were acquired. Six gas phase fractionated DIA runs of overlapping isolation window of 4 m/z and a mass range of 100 m/z (400-500 m/z, 500-600 m/z, 600-700 m/z, 700-800 m/z, 800-900 m/z, and 900-1000 m/z) were prepared from the pool of the biological samples to prepare the spectral library.
dataProcessingProtocol: Mass spectrometry raw data were processed by Spectronaut software (version 16.2) using spectral library prepared from the gas phase fractionated DIA runs. The spectral library was generated with a FASTA database containing human reviewed sequences along with their isoforms of UniprotKB release of 2022_01. Carbamidomethyl (C) as fixed modification and M oxidation and N-terminal protein acetylation were set as variable modification. A maximum of two missed cleavages was allowed and the false discovery rate was set at 1%. Precursors were filtered with q value and quantitation was done at MS2 level based on peak areas. Statistical analyses were done with Perseus (version 1.6.14.0) based on MS2 quantification data. Welch's T test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR of 0.05 was used to identify statistically significant proteins from the comparisons.
